result.title: Beyond Unit Tests: Path-Aware Rubric-Guided LLM Autograding of Notebooks
result.summary: Jupyter notebooks support open-ended, multi-step assessments in which students build one logical flow across interdependent steps, combining code, written analysis, and generated outputs such as plots. These reflect authentic scientific practice but are hard to grade consistently, since students may make different yet equally valid choices at each step, so a later answer can only be judged in light of the choices a student made earlier. We present an LLM-based autograder for such flow-structured notebook questions. It generates a rubric from a reference solution, then applies a softening pass that relaxes criteria tied to the reference so legitimate alternative paths are not penalized. Each question group is graded in a single model call, so later answers are judged against the student's own earlier choices, using question-type tags and schema-constrained, low-temperature outputs. Evidence is scored multimodally: code, text, numerical outputs, and figures from code cells. We deployed the tool in a machine-learning course, integrated with Gradescope, with a pre-submission format check and prompt-injection defenses, and evaluate it both in that live course and against archived submissions graded by staff in earlier terms. We report agreement, cross-model variance, cost, student perceptions, and injection resilience. With low-temperature models, agreement with human scores is often strong, including on the open-ended items the design specifically targets, while run-to-run stability depends sharply on the model's temperature support.

AI.brief_summary: 论文面向 Jupyter notebook 中跨步骤关联的开放式作业，先从参考解生成评分 rubric 并做「软化」以容纳合法替代解法，再按题组单次调用 LLM、结合代码、文本、数值与图像进行路径感知的自动评分，并在真实课程与存档提交上评估与人评分的一致性、跨模型方差、成本与学生观感。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接关联，教育评分属远端领域；但其「依前序选择判定后续步骤」及软化 rubric 以免惩罚合法替代路径的思路，可能可供核查多步推理轨迹的路径级评价与替代 latent 路径的容错计分设计。
